input:
When the reported values for the benchmark material are placed side by side, it becomes apparent that the two sets of pressure drop values stand apart by considerably more than the scatter that either group reports within its own runs, and it would seem that the gap follows the test conditions rather than the material itself. It should be emphasised that both groups were working with the same class of material, and neither set of values can simply be set aside as a measurement error on the face of the reports as they stand.

Looking more closely at the conditions, these differ in the state of the bed and in the flow through it, both of which are factors of some importance in this context. One of the groups measured its values on a bed that had been packed for the test and reported the packing alongside the results, whereas the other group took its values under conditions carried over from an earlier programme, with the bed state described only in part. Since the pressure drop across a packed bed answers to both of these factors, a value that is moved from one set of conditions to the other inevitably carries the difference along with it.

The preference that is reached here is, it must be said, a limited one. Where a design case happens to run near the conditions of the first group, the first group's values would appear to be the better basis, essentially because the bed state behind them is known and the flow range covers the case in question. The preference rests, in other words, on that closeness of conditions. It does not extend to cases run under the second group's conditions, and it settles nothing about the benchmark material beyond the range that the first group covered.

Pressure drop across a packed bed answers to both, so a value moved from one set of conditions to the other carries the difference with it.

The preference reached here is limited. Where a design case runs near the conditions of the first group, the first group's values are the better basis, because the bed state behind them is known and the flow range covers the case.
